statement: For both fixed curated networks at the enumerated conditions, ExoGibbs satisfies numerical closure gates and agrees with independently initialized FastChem solutions within the declared all-species abundance tolerance.
revision_rationale: Explicitly replace outcome-bearing wording and enumerate gates from the inspected validator. This revision concerns the 70-case numerical comparison only. It does not import the old supported status, cover new grid points, judge source adoption, or establish physical accuracy. FastChem receives the same constants and composition, so solver independence is not independent thermochemical validation.
